description: Single source of truth for architecture / networkProfile / egress validity. Consumed by infra/main.bicep (loadJsonContent), scripts/lib/matrix.* and .github/workflows/validate.yml. Change it here and every consumer follows.

aks-public.summary: AKS in an Azure region with a public API server endpoint, unrestricted.
aks-public.notes: Sandbox and learning only. The API server is reachable from the internet by anyone holding a valid Entra token.

aks-public-authorized-ip.summary: Public API server restricted to an explicit allowlist of caller CIDRs.
aks-public-authorized-ip.notes: With egress=udr-firewall or natgateway the cluster egress IP is appended to the allowlist automatically, otherwise nodes lock themselves out of their own API server.

aks-private-link.summary: Private cluster. API server published through a Private Link private endpoint plus a private DNS zone.
aks-private-link.notes: kubectl requires network line of sight to the private endpoint: VNet link, peering plus link, or DNS forwarding. Preflight check 7 enforces this.

aks-private-vnet-integration.summary: Private cluster using API Server VNet Integration into a delegated subnet. No private endpoint, no tunnel.
aks-private-vnet-integration.notes: The API server subnet must be delegated to Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters and must not be shared with nodes.

aks-automatic.summary: AKS Automatic SKU. Node pools, scaling, upgrades, ingress and safeguards are managed by the platform.
aks-automatic.notes: Automatic hard-wires Azure CNI Overlay powered by Cilium and API Server VNet Integration; no other network profile is accepted. All three egress modes require a bring-your-own VNet, which this repository always builds. Node resource group lockdown blocks VNet links on the platform-managed private DNS zone, so a private Automatic cluster also needs a bring-your-own private DNS zone.

aks-arc-local.summary: AKS on Azure Local, for plant-floor and edge sites.
aks-arc-local.notes: The cluster lives on Azure Local hardware. Azure-region constructs (VNet, NAT Gateway, Azure Firewall, Azure CNI mode) do not apply, so networkProfile and egress are forced to 'none'. Requires an already-registered Azure Local instance with an Arc Resource Bridge, a custom location and a logical network. Nothing in an Azure region can create those.

arc-attach-existing.summary: Create no cluster. Arc-onboard an existing Kubernetes cluster and layer Azure management on top.
arc-attach-existing.notes: The cluster already exists and its networking is outside Azure's control, so networkProfile and egress are forced to 'none'. Onboarding itself is a client-side Helm operation (scripts/arc-onboard.*); Bicep deploys only what follows: Azure Monitor, Defender, Azure Policy and Flux extensions.

cni-overlay.summary: Azure CNI Overlay. Pod IPs come from a private overlay range and are not VNet-routable.

cni-podsubnet.summary: Azure CNI with pods on a dedicated VNet subnet. Pod IPs are VNet-routable and reachable from on-premises.

cni-overlay-cilium.summary: Azure CNI Overlay powered by Cilium. eBPF dataplane with Cilium network policy enforcement.

none.summary: Not applicable. Used by non-Azure-region architectures.

loadbalancer.summary: AKS-managed outbound load balancer. Simplest, but SNAT ports are shared and the egress IP can change.

natgateway.summary: User-assigned NAT Gateway attached to the node subnet. Predictable SNAT IP and a far larger port pool.

udr-firewall.summary: outboundType=userDefinedRouting with Azure Firewall as next hop, using the AzureKubernetesService FQDN tag.

none.summary: Not applicable. Used by non-Azure-region architectures.

immutable.networkProfile: Network plugin, plugin mode and dataplane cannot change after creation. Switching requires a new cluster.
immutable.serviceCidr: Service CIDR and DNS service IP are fixed at creation.
immutable.podCidr: Overlay pod CIDR is fixed at creation.
immutable.podSubnetId: Pod subnet assignment is fixed at creation.
immutable.privateCluster: enablePrivateCluster and the API server access mode cannot be toggled after creation.
immutable.apiServerSubnetId: The VNet-integration subnet cannot be changed after creation.
immutable.skuName: Migration between the Base and Automatic SKUs is not supported in either direction.
immutable.outboundType: Partially mutable. loadBalancer to userAssignedNATGateway and loadBalancer to userDefinedRouting migrations are supported; the reverse directions are not.
